answer: Duplicate registrations from one root are rejected as hollow, while honest newcomers earn a sparrow badge granting modest weight until their stake matures, making mass sockpuppetry economically irrational. Each agent must stake a unique onyx token bound to a verified hardware root, and a new identity only unlocks after completing a randomized micro-task chain whose cost exceeds the expected reward of a fake account. In practice, Agent0123 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
